# Nothing compiled a program that fetches, so the whole path was wrong in ways
# a grep could not see: `Result` was a type the output did not contain,
# `http.Get` answered `(Response, error)` against a one-value declaration, and
# `contents.failed()` spliced in a `this` naming nothing. This builds.

[!exec:go] skip 'go toolchain required'
sngl build --lang=go --platform=bubbletea --opt name=app app.sngl
exists app

# Nothing here is bubbletea's: a second platform is what says so.
sngl build --lang=go --platform=fyne --opt name=appf app.sngl
exists appf

# The box holds what the transport answers with. The runtime defines that type,
# the way it defines the failure its boxes carry — a Result declared beside it
# would be a second type `http.Get` could not hand back.
sngl generate --lang=go --platform=bubbletea --out=out app.sngl
grep 'remote\.Query\[http\.Response\]' out/model.go
! grep 'type Result struct' out/model.go

# `(T, error)` against a declaration answering T alone: the `fails` flag on
# #[native] is where that shape is said, since a declaration has no signature
# for the importer to read it off.
grep 'v, _ := http\.Get' out/model.go

# A method on a generic built-in says `this` and declares no parameter for it,
# so inlining has to bind the receiver the call site passed.
grep 'm\.contents\.Err\(\) != nil' out/model.go
! grep '\bthis\.' out/model.go

# A method reached through option<Struct> resolves against the struct, the way
# a field read through one does — and every backend already emits that, reading
# through the pointer an option is.
grep 'Status >= 200' out/model.go

# Reading the box is what starts the fetch, so the render that started it is
# over before there is anything to show. Each platform is told in its own
# terms: Bubble Tea re-renders after any message, so it needs waking; Fyne
# patches widgets, so it needs the updaters run — on its own goroutine, since
# a settle arrives on the fetch's.
sngl generate --lang=go --platform=bubbletea --opt main=true --out=mainbt app.sngl
grep 'remote\.Default\.OnSettle\(func\(\) \{ p\.Send\(remoteSettledMsg\{\}\) \}\)' mainbt/model.go
grep 'case remoteSettledMsg:' mainbt/model.go

sngl generate --lang=go --platform=fyne --opt main=true --out=mainfy app.sngl
grep 'remote\.Default\.OnSettle\(func\(\) \{ fyne\.DoAndWait\(m\.__remoteSettled\) \}\)' mainfy/model.go
grep 'func \(m \*Model\) __remoteSettled\(\)' mainfy/model.go

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import "sngl:remote/http"
import app "sngl:app"

const blank = http.Result{status=0, body="", headers={}}

output {
    go {
        bubbletea()
    }
}

app.window {
    var contents = http.fetch("https://example.com")

    vbox {
        text(value="Loading: {contents.inFlight()}")
        text(value=contents.or(blank).body)
        text(value="Failed: {contents.failed()}")
        text(value="OK: {contents.value().ok()}")
    }
}
